deck.title: Sparta Explorer — Inspectable Space-Cyber Assurance
deck.subtitle: Trace a conclusion from framework guidance to program evidence and human review
deck.audience: Aerospace and defense design partners, assessors, engineers, cyber analysts, and program leads
deck.author: Graham Anderson

sources.title: Sparta Explorer implementation and proof overview

claims.text: Trace a space-cyber conclusion from framework guidance to program evidence and human review without letting AI turn relevance into authority.

claims.text: Sparta Explorer turns scattered space-cyber, engineering, supplier, and test evidence into one inspectable decision thread.

claims.text: The product helps teams ask why a conclusion is believed, what is missing or disputed, and who is allowed to decide.

evidence_spans.text: It helps a team answer three practical questions:
**Why do we believe this?**
**What is missing, stale, disputed, or still only a candidate?**
**Who is allowed to decide?**
